long_biography.plain_text:
Müller joined his family's packaging company in 1986, when it employed 35 people. He combined it with the Tricor heavy-duty corrugated specialist and Transcor logistics operation, creating an integrated packaging and transport group. Investments in plants, patents and European subsidiaries helped the business become Germany's market leader in heavy corrugated board.

In 2019 Müller and his co-owners sold a majority stake to Japan's Rengo as part of a succession plan. He left Tricor's board three years later, after a transition period. Müller now serves as a managing director of Built4Future, developing energy-efficient housing in Bavaria, alongside roles in property, investment and renewable-energy companies. Those projects and entities are company ventures, not assets attributed to him personally.

Tricor's plants, patents and logistics network passed to Rengo. Built4Future developments and the assets of MWWHG, Energiezukunft Unterallgäu and other entities are company ventures and are not attributed to Müller personally.
